title: tilia glabra var. macrophylla
intro: Tilia glabra var. macrophylla, commonly known as Large-leaved Small-leaved Lime, is a variant of the Tilia glabra species, a type of deciduous tree native to Eastern Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Tilia glabra var. macrophylla include calming the nervous system and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent, which may contribute to its use in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and volatile oils, such as limonene and terpinen-4-ol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
